targets.why_now: FCSC, SON and Federal Ministry of Finance have all issued 2026 warnings about false recruitment or impersonation information.
targets.buyer_question: Could an external monitoring layer detect false official notices faster and measure correction lag?
targets.pilot: Weekly official-information integrity brief for one agency/service.

targets.why_now: NCC publishes complaint statistics and has a 2026 QoS compensation framework based on measured service failures.
targets.buyer_question: What external signals would reveal emerging service friction before or alongside internal complaint/QoS systems?
targets.pilot: Monthly aggregated service-friction brief for one geography/service category.

targets.why_now: NERC operates a multi-step complaint redress system, creating a measurable service-friction workflow.
targets.buyer_question: Can aggregated external signals identify changing complaint themes or unresolved service friction not visible in formal channels?

targets.why_now: NAFDAC's strategy includes surveillance, investigations and enforcement around substandard/falsified/counterfeit regulated products.
targets.buyer_question: Where are authenticity risks or verification gaps emerging across product categories and channels?

validation_protocol: Identify the specific decision-maker and existing data system.
Document the information gap before pitching a solution.
Offer one small intelligence brief rather than a platform sale.
Measure whether the buyer finds the signal new, timely and actionable.
Only then define recurring pricing/API requirements.
privacy_boundary: Do not sell names, contact lists, identifiable complainants, private messages or individual behavioural profiles.
